title: Shopping
objective: Buy clothes in a shop: ask for a size and colour, try something on and pay.
opening: Hi there! Let me know if you need any help finding something.
targetSentences: Do you have this in a smaller size?
Could I have a receipt, please?
mainQuest: Buy clothes in a shop: check the size, try something on, ask the price and pay.

questSteps.text: Ask for a smaller size and ask to try it on.
questSteps.hint: 先问尺码，再问能不能试
anchors: Do you have this in a smaller size?

questSteps.text: Pay and ask for a receipt.
anchors: Could I have a receipt, please?
